title.zh: 可解释的 NSFW 文本审核

context.zh: 硕士二年级秋季学季，月份依据 UC Davis 校历范围换算
context.en: Second-year master's fall quarter; months inferred from the UC Davis academic calendar

context.zh: Raymond Kang 与魏允瀚合作；个人贡献边界依据报告作者分工记录
context.en: Collaboration between Raymond Kang and Yunhan Wei; individual scope follows the report's author-contribution statement

summary.zh: 团队构建了结合 RoBERTa、RISE 与后验概念瓶颈模型的可解释文本审核系统；魏允瀚负责可视化与用户体验、仪表板设计、可用性研究工具及前端实现。
summary.en: The team built an interpretable text-moderation system combining RoBERTa, RISE, and a post-hoc concept bottleneck model; Yunhan Wei owned visualization and UX, dashboard design, usability-study instruments, and front-end implementation.

zh: 把模型判断转化为审核人员可读的多层解释
在一个界面中同时呈现词元、概念和分类结果
en: Translate model decisions into layered explanations that moderators can inspect
Present token-, concept-, and classification-level evidence in one interface

zh: 使用互补视图区分局部词元证据与高层概念解释
将三类解释集中在 Streamlit 仪表板中，支持并排理解
en: Use complementary views to separate local token evidence from higher-level concept explanations
Unify three explanation views in a Streamlit dashboard for side-by-side interpretation

zh: 报告记录了分词器特殊符号和前导空格标记对可读性的影响
识别出“sexual content”概念样本不均衡；由于时间限制，可用性研究尚未执行
en: The report documents readability issues from tokenizer special tokens and leading-space markers
Identified imbalance in the sexual-content concept; the usability study was not run because of time constraints

zh: 负责可解释 NSFW 文本审核系统的可视化与 UX、Streamlit 仪表板设计及前端实现，整合词元显著性热图、概念激活条形图与词元—概念矩阵。
设计可用性研究工具，并梳理分词器符号、概念样本不均衡等解释可读性问题；模型训练与 0.8705 验证准确率为团队系统成果。
en: Owned visualization and UX, Streamlit dashboard design, and front-end implementation for an interpretable NSFW text-moderation system, integrating token saliency, concept activations, and a token–concept matrix.

Designed usability-study instruments and documented explanation-readability issues such as tokenizer artifacts and concept imbalance; model training and 0.8705 validation accuracy were team-level system results.

website.zh: 该团队项目使用 RoBERTa、RISE 与后验概念瓶颈模型解释 NSFW 文本分类。魏允瀚负责将模型输出整理为可用界面：通过词元显著性、概念激活和词元—概念关系三个互补视图，帮助用户理解分类依据。
website.en: This team project explains NSFW text classification with RoBERTa, RISE, and a post-hoc concept bottleneck model. Yunhan Wei turned model outputs into a usable interface with three complementary views: token saliency, concept activation, and token–concept relationships.

full.zh: 系统将基础分类器的局部特征归因与高层概念解释组合在同一 Streamlit 仪表板中。魏允瀚负责可视化与用户体验、仪表板设计、可用性研究工具及前端实现；Raymond Kang 负责基础模型微调、RISE 适配、概念头训练、数据集、指标和研究执行。报告中的 0.8705 验证准确率属于团队系统成果，不归因于任何单一成员。
full.en: The system combines local feature attribution from the base classifier with higher-level concept explanations in one Streamlit dashboard. Yunhan Wei was responsible for visualization and UX, dashboard design, usability-study instruments, and front-end implementation; Raymond Kang handled base-model fine-tuning, RISE adaptation, concept-head training, datasets, metrics, and study execution. The reported 0.8705 validation accuracy is a team-level system result, not an individual claim.

sources: Raymond Kang's public project repository and branch
